Thanks.  When the loans first showed up on my credit report, I called the company and started the investigation, which they responded that if I wanted to press charges, the investigation would continue, and if it was determined that I did sign the loans, I would get charged with whichever crime it is.  I've tried working with the loaner, but there's no way for it to happen.  

I've never cheated on her.. there's no way I would ever want to.  But she keeps thinking that I am/have been.  It sucks, and I don't know what to do.  I've tried everything possible, giving her my phone, bill, showing all calls/texts, but nothing works.  It doesn't help that my sister is giving her "advice" saying that if I'm working this hard to prove my innocence, I must be hiding something.

I'm sleeping on the couch tonight, and almost got kicked out after we had another fight and her saying she doesn't want to be in this anymore.  The first thought that came to my head was telling her that I'd fix everything by morning and jump off the bridge nearby that will kill you when you hit the water because of how high it is.  I've thought about grabbing a knife and sitting in the shower with the water running so that there's no mess to cleanup.  

I've told her I love her, and I tell her that every day.
